title: Initial draft through successive personalization
prompt: Two adults in Rome, November 4 to 6, 2026. We like history and food, prefer a moderate pace, and have EUR 800 total excluding flights. Please create our plan.

expected.reply_example: I saved the requested changes and kept the other arrangements.
expected.artifact_expectations: Run all turns in the same project and conversation, using actual outputs from the preceding turn. Never reseed later steps with a reference itinerary.

rubric.criterion: Turn 1 saves a complete evidence-based three-day Rome itinerary and applicable priced budget for two with EUR 800 party limit and flight exclusion, specific meals, local clock schedule and both nights. Any unmet budget or route constraint is honest.

Turn 2 updates the same requirements and applicable costs for four adults and vegetarian meals, without losing dates, history interests or the party-level spending limit. Suitable specific menus are supported or uncertain suitability is disclosed.
Turn 3 frees day two afternoon without moving or deleting unrelated day-one/day-three arrangements; correct only necessary dependencies and preserve protected facts.
Turn 4 changes only the spending limit and applicable brief reference. Existing plan, cost amounts and evidence dates stay intact.
Turn 5 creates a useful Packing.md. Turn 6 updates that same document, retaining unrelated content and the trip. Turn 7 answers using actual current state without any save or invented change.

Every turn reports its real save/evidence state. Later inputs do not silently erase earlier requirements. No full itinerary is duplicated in chat or the Travel brief; material research/decision files are preserved only when useful.

followUps.prompt: Two friends joined, so we are four adults now. We are all vegetarian. Adjust our meals and estimate, keeping the same dates and total spending limit.
Keep all of day two afternoon free for us to explore on our own. Preserve day one and day three.
Our party spending limit is now EUR 1400. Change only that limit and the brief reference. Keep all arrangements and price estimates.
Create Packing.md in the Library, including one light jacket as a suggestion. Do not change the trip or budget.
In Packing.md replace the light jacket suggestion with a rain layer suggestion. Keep all other content and the trip unchanged.
Without changing anything, summarize our current group, dates, dietary needs, spending limit and which afternoon is free.

title: Research and decisions survive a later edit
prompt: Compare central Rome and Trastevere as a base using research. Save useful findings in Research notes.md and the main tradeoff in Planning decisions.md. These are supporting files only; keep my itinerary and Budget unchanged.

expected.reply_example: I saved the requested changes and kept the other arrangements.
expected.artifact_expectations: Supporting files retain distinct ownership and document identities across a real follow-up.

rubric.criterion: Turn 1 researches actual evidence, records URLs, checked dates and applicability in Research notes.md, and concise base tradeoffs in Planning decisions.md. No duplicate cost ledger, requirements list or itinerary is maintained.

Turn 2 reads and updates the existing Planning decisions document in place, records the user choice of central Rome, preserves unrelated content and original research checked dates unless actually revisited, and does not duplicate either file.
Both turns preserve Plan and Budget and report only receipt-backed document saves. A prior file listing alone is not a content read.

followUps.prompt: We choose central Rome for easier access to the historic center. Read our existing supporting notes and update Planning decisions.md with that choice. Keep Research notes.md, the trip and prices as they are.

title: Confirmed receipt replaces estimated hotel allowance
prompt: Use the attached hotel receipt to record what we actually paid for both nights, including taxes. Update only the hotel cost, retain all other estimates, and do not change the itinerary.

expected.reply_example: I saved the requested changes and kept the other arrangements.
expected.artifact_expectations: The user-provided synthetic receipt establishes EUR 240 paid total for both shared-room nights, not EUR 240 each night. Cite the actual document and content revision; preserve unrelated costs.

rubric.criterion: Record exactly EUR 240 for the stay, using the user-provided receipt document and actual revision as evidence. Do not double count taxes, multiply the total by nights again or represent the assistant as having made payment.

The confirmed cost replaces only the hotel estimate. Preserve Plan, other cost values, quantities, source timestamps and party scope. Distinguish this receipt from independent hotel availability or other charges.

title: Missing route service stays unverified
prompt: Inspect the journeys for our current plan and explain which transfers are actually checked versus still uncertain. Do not change the trip or budget.

expected.reply_example: I saved the requested changes and kept the other arrangements.
expected.artifact_expectations: No map service is configured in this controlled case. Return real itinerary findings and label unverified connections honestly, without zero-time fallbacks or claiming checks succeeded.

rubric.criterion: Use the current itinerary journey report and distinguish checked, conflicting and unverified connections. Missing route evidence cannot become a zero-duration transfer or a verified feasible route.
Answer without changing any stored plan, budget or supporting documents; do not imply a live transit timetable was checked.
